name: Hangzhou Qiandaohu Xunlong Sci-tech Co., Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou Qiandaohu Xunlong Sci-tech Co., Ltd. produces, processes, markets and exports caviar, selling in China and internationally. Caviar types include hybrid sturgeon, Russian sturgeon, kaluga, beluga, amur and Siberian sturgeon, along with sturgeon meat, supported by breeding, aquaculture and processing.
